title: Pipe names
description:
Build and check named pipe names.

```
pipeName("xenon-build")          -> \\.\pipe\xenon-build
pipeName("xenon-build", session) -> \\.\pipe\xenon-build-S1
"bad\name"                       -> refused: backslash not allowed
a 300-character name             -> refused: longer than 256
```
hints: In C++ source, `"\\\\.\\pipe\\"` is the text `\\.\pipe\`; a raw string `R"(\\.\pipe\)"` is easier to read (lesson 2.02).
Add the session to the name so two users on one machine do not share a pipe.
requirements: The prefix is `\\.\pipe\`; the name after it may not contain `\` and is at most 256 characters in total.
An optional suffix keeps different user sessions apart.
Print names with the backslashes visible.
stretch: Add a random part to the name for a private pipe between a parent and its child.
